premise: Raccoon wants a peekaboo game; sleepy Bear cub and jumpy Rabbit play it wrong, until the best BOO makes them all giggle.
inspiration: The folk pattern of three tries (the third one works), turned so the tries are friends' funny mistakes and the success is shared.
lesson: Games are best when you play them together.

en-US.title: Raccoon Plays Peekaboo
en-US.text: [excited] Along came {raccoon:enter} Raccoon with a brand-new game. {raccoon:face happy} Who wants to play peekaboo? {bear:enter} Bear cub came toddling over. {bear:face happy} I'll try, he said. He {bear:live} gave a big yawn, stretched, rubbed his eyes… and nodded off! {sfx:snore solo} Then he woke with a start, blinked, and smiled. [giggles] That's not peekaboo, said Raccoon. {rabbit:enter} Rabbit came hopping over the grass. I'll try! His ears {rabbit:live} shot up. He listened, very still… then found a clover leaf and nibbled it. {raccoon:face surprised} That's not peekaboo either! [curious] Watch me, said Raccoon. He {raccoon:live hold} rubbed his paws and hid his eyes. [whispers] Where did Raccoon go? Bear cub and Rabbit {bear:face surprised} {rabbit:face surprised} leaned in close… {raccoon:live resume} He peeked through his paws… [surprised] and flung them wide. BOO! Bear cub {bear:wobble} tumbled back. Rabbit {rabbit:spin} spun around. {all:face happy} [laughs] And all three giggled {all:hearts} until their tummies shook.

es-ES.title: Mapache juega al cucú-tras
es-ES.text: [excited] Llegó {raccoon:enter} Mapache con un juego nuevo. {raccoon:face happy} ¿Quién quiere jugar al cucú-tras? {bear:enter} Osito se acercó caminando despacito. {bear:face happy} Yo, dijo. {bear:live} Dio un bostezo enorme, se estiró, se frotó los ojos… ¡y se quedó dormido! {sfx:snore solo} Luego se despertó de un respingo, parpadeó y sonrió. [giggles] Eso no es cucú-tras, dijo Mapache. {rabbit:enter} Conejo llegó dando saltos por la hierba. ¡Yo! {rabbit:live} Levantó las orejas bien tiesas. Escuchó, muy quieto… y luego encontró un trébol y lo mordisqueó. {raccoon:face surprised} ¡Eso tampoco es cucú-tras! [curious] Mirad, dijo Mapache. {raccoon:live hold} Se frotó las patitas y se tapó los ojos. [whispers] ¿Dónde está Mapache? Osito y Conejo {bear:face surprised} {rabbit:face surprised} se acercaron un poquito… {raccoon:live resume} Mapache espió entre los dedos… [surprised] y abrió las patas de par en par. ¡CUCÚ-TRAS! Osito {bear:wobble} se cayó hacia atrás. Conejo {rabbit:spin} dio una vuelta. {all:face happy} [laughs] Y los tres se rieron {all:hearts} hasta que les temblaba la barriga.

snore.prompt: a tiny bear cub's soft, cute sleepy snore, one breath in and out
